'''Henne Kallea''' was the mother of [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] and the wife of [[Olun Kallea]]. She was a member of [[House Kallea]] on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Henne and Olun wished their daughter to marry into a higher ranked house, though Freia had planned to apprentice in the [[Brentaal Spacefarers League]] to both their disapproval.<ref name="EA" />
